character: big bronze turkey, floral shorts unchanged, ploughs forward body first, fills two thirds of the frame
props: sauce bucket he boots along the sand ahead of his feet, intact all clip; huge painted platter half-sunk in the sand ahead, gilded rim, in frame all clip; hourglass in the tail poult's wing all clip; wide brush in the smallest poult's hands; three downy poults whose place is his body, never the ground
motion_rule: all three poults touch him every window - wings, chest, tail base; he fights back every window - wrenching, kicking, elbowing - never merely walks; new angle and shot size every window
environment: wet sand, bright sunny midday, hard shadows; background under a third of the frame

audio.delivery: weary male voice, native Russian stress, deadpan
audio.pronunciation: stress: OT-pusk, na-DYE-yesh-sya, do-ZHIT, chet-ver-GA, GLAV-nym, BLYU-dom, VYER-no
audio.pacing: lively even pacing, no drawling, each line fits its window
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, never a voice-over
audio.sfx: sand scraping, feathers thumping, sauce sloshing

timeline.a: boots the bucket toward the platter in the sand | two poults swing on his wings, third rides his tail base with the hourglass
wrenches his wing up to shake the pair off, ploughs on | they latch back, chest poult lays an orange stroke
his other foot boots the bucket on, he treads his own orange trail | tail poult digs in and is dragged
elbows the left poult in the ribs, stride unbroken | it slides to his hip, the other climbs his shoulder
jerks his chest off the brush, leans forward hauling all three | that poult drags an orange stroke across him
fans his tail, flinging the rear poult wide, striding on | it swings out, hangs on again, hourglass kept
kicks a heel back at the tail poult, misses, spins half a step | it grips higher and brakes him
throws his head over his shoulder, snaps at the brush, feet never planting | the stroke runs up his neck
shakes off both wings in one heave, stride unbroken | both poults are tossed up and slap back down
boots the bucket over the platter rim and trips after it, falls chest first onto it | the loosened pair ride his back down
slides across the glaze and sprawls in the platter, the tipped bucket washing orange over him | tail poult drives its heels in
presses his chest off the glaze on one wing elbow | smallest poult puts the brush in his wing, pats his side
kneels in the platter, pulls two strokes on his own chest | two poults hang on his shoulders watching
stops mid-stroke, turns his head into the lens | tail poult stands the hourglass on the platter rim and turns it

must_appear: bucket, platter and hourglass from 0.0; bucket booted ahead of his feet all clip; orange strokes on his chest at 2.9 and 9.0; his feet never plant before 7.6; he lands in the platter at 7.6; hourglass turned at 9.5
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, captions, watermark, cyrillic letters, numbers, readable text, static camera, same shot size twice, only his head moving, the poults away from him, a window where the poults do nothing, deformed anatomy, character changing mid-shot, English speech, any word after 6.9, kitchen, oven, props in mid-air
